divisions.title: Judgment on the Nations
divisions.theme: God turns His judgment toward Israel
divisions.summary: Damascus, Gaza, Tyre, Edom, Ammon, Moab, Judah, and finally Israel itself stand condemned

divisions.title: Amos Confronts Israel
divisions.summary: Amos condemns oppression of the poor, dishonest merchants, and religious ritual without justice

divisions.title: Amos's Visions
divisions.summary: Five visions of doom; Amaziah opposes Amos; yet David's fallen tent will be raised
